name: card-generator-extension
description: Browser extension for Luhn-valid card generation and Stripe autofill

scripts.test: node tests/luhn.test.js && node tests/core.test.js && node tests/manifest.test.js && node tests/build.test.js && node tests/tooling.test.js && node tests/autofill-diagnostics.test.js
scripts.format: prettier --config config/.prettierrc --write src scripts tests *.md package.json
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.validate:extensions: npm run build && node scripts/validate-extensions.js && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox --warnings-as-errors
scripts.zip: npm run build && node scripts/zip.js all
scripts.zip:chromium: npm run build && node scripts/zip.js chromium
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/zip.js firefox
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build && npm run open:extensions

author: adxptived
